name: needless-repaint
title: Diagnostic: needless repaint
summary: Deliberately flawed: a static card whose corner radius is 20 + 0 * continuousSec(), a time read with no visible effect that still makes the document repaint every frame (audit repaint_continuous).
prompt: A static card that reads continuousSec() in an expression with no visible effect.
teaches: Recognise repaint_continuous: any operation that listens to continuousSec() puts the document on a repaint-every-frame loop, even when the value changes nothing on screen
Find the culprit in the finding's cause (the FloatExpression listening to $CONTINUOUS_SEC) and replace it with a constant

check.describe: audit reports only repaint_continuous (info), whose cause is 1 operation listening to $CONTINUOUS_SEC (the FloatExpression for rx); the card itself renders as a static teal card. Resized, the background fills the box and the card stretches to the width with 30 dp margins, centred vertically; it still repaints every frame.

pitfalls: The plan's animationTime() does not trigger it: the engine's repaint schedule (RemoteComposeState.getOpsToUpdate) only looks at listeners on continuousSec, timeInSec and timeInMin, so a FloatExpression reading animationTime() alone is reported idle; continuousSec() is the read that costs a frame loop
